source.status: Unreleased experimental module beside Character Designer 0.77.41; not deployed by this review

trigger_evidence.observation: The independent copied catalog row retained the same original unlinked Object pointer. Stage04 correctly refused it.

accepted_policy: Clear only an independently owned copied Scene CharacterDesignerAsset.object pointer whose corresponding source Object is outside the source Scene and unlinked from every Scene.
Preserve catalog rows, roles, ordering and active index. Do not delete, link, copy or modify the orphan Object.
Reject any external catalog Object belonging to another Scene. Keep generic external Object-reference rejection unchanged.
Gather all candidate-row admissions and animation/driver gates before the first detachment. Read back each changed clone pointer and its unchanged source pointer/role.
Reject nested Scene NLA before detachment; the current Scene Action collector deliberately does not provide nested-strip isolation.
Reject Scene Action/NLA and Scene-driver paths containing character_designer_setup. Reject graph-driver targets at that Scene with matching paths and explicit matching driver expressions.
Require every SCRIPTED driver inspected for this admission to have is_simple_expression true, preventing arbitrary Python/namespace indirection from being treated as independent catalog metadata.
Record each detached path, source Object name and source session UID in session inspection. Dispose the entire owned clone graph if later construction fails.

canonical_reader_evidence.finding: The stored Object pointer has poll only and no get/update callback. Role and footwear resolution filter current Scene membership. Binding/selection/catalog changes require explicit operators.
Hair/Skirt source-selection fallback uses role_source, which already excludes unlinked Hair1.
Explicit visual fitting reads the catalog and excludes objects outside the current Scene.
Export/UI catalog hints are filtered by Scene membership and actual enabled Armature binding; the orphan cannot add an exportable mesh.

review_checks.legacy_action_fcurves_fallback: Blender 5.2 RNA defines channelbag.fcurves and no Action.fcurves property; getattr(action, 'fcurves', ()) therefore safely falls back after the layered traversal.
review_checks.root_reported_pure_tests: 18 passed, including nested META NLA and indirect Python-driver rejection; reviewer inspected implementation and regression source without rerunning native work

limits: Source review of this field-specific isolation policy only, not a general Python dependency-closure or every-plugin callback proof.
Native Blender copy ownership, property setter behavior, all-frame geometry, Action preservation, cleanup and performance still require the new isolated validation stage.
A setter failure can leave partial changes only on the owned clone; builder-level failure cleanup must succeed before resource release.
This review made no runtime-source edits, native Blender run, GUI action, artist mutation, deployment or scene save. Only this new small evidence file was written.
